title: Sanctum Assault
short_description: Top-down isometric arena wave survival — three champions, dual Warrior weapon modes, five mystical realm boards, combos, Shock, and juicy combat.
description: Sanctum Assault is a polished top-down 3D arena fighter. Choose Warrior, Archer, or Mage and fight escalating enemy legions across five premium realm boards — Ember Crucible, Frostveil Circle, Stormspire Board, Umbral Fen, and Solar Bastion. Warrior swaps between Two-Handed and Sword & Shield kits mid-fight (including Block and Shield Bash Shock). Spamable basics, radial ability cooldowns, combo multipliers, burn/frost ground residuals, WAVE CLEAR banners, and a final REALM CLEARED victory screen. Desktop keyboard and mobile virtual joystick supported.
controls_keyboard: WASD/ZQSD move · Mouse aim · LMB/J basic · 1-3 abilities · Q/Tab Warrior mode swap · Shift/K block (S&S) · Esc pause
